Licensed iGaming affiliate economics depend on approved jurisdictions, qualified-player CPA or permitted revenue share, fraud reversals, and operator terms, so gross signups and customer deposits are not earned affiliate revenue.

flow: Define separate terminal and affiliate offerings, approved markets, and activities requiring legal review.

Net revenue against data costs, acquisition spend, cancellations, reversals, and compliance overhead.
